author: National Geographic
description:
In this full episode of Inside the CIA: Secrets and Spies from National Geographic, open up the CIA's case files to learn about the arrest of an American in Pakistan that threatens one of the agency's most secretive missions ever. What happens when a covert CIA mission abroad is compromised? In the wake of the arrest, Mark Kelton, the chief of the station, must navigate the fallout.
